043114: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result)
043115: {
043116:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index];
043117:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("false"))))
043118:     {
043119:         *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->bool_type, string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")));
043120:         return true;
043121:     }
043122:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("nullptr")))
043123:     {
043124:         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = builder->nullptr_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER};
043125:         return true;
043126:     }
043127:     CEntityId entity_id = c_ir_constant_entity_at(builder, token_index);
043128:     if (entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
043129:     {
043130:         CEntity* entity = builder->parse.entities + entity_id.value;
043131:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR || (entity->is_constexpr && entity->has_constant_value))
043132:         {
043133:             IrTypeId type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : builder->s32_type;
043134:             u64 value = entity->constant_value;
043135:             if (entity->constant_is_negative)
043136:             {
043137:                 value = 0 - value;
043138:             }
043139:             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : type, value);
043140:             return true;
043141:         }
043142:         // A function-local static is C_ENTITY_LOCAL with a symbol -- the
043143:         // clinic macros write `.kwtuple = (&_kwtuple.ob_base.ob_base)` where
043144:         // _kwtuple is exactly that -- and it folds like any file-scope
043145:         // object.  An automatic local has no symbol and stays refused.
043146:         bool static_local = entity->kind == C_ENTITY_LOCAL && builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
043147:         if ((entity->kind == C_ENTITY_OBJECT || static_local) && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
043148:         {
043149:             IrSymbolId symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value];
043150:             IrTypeId type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
043151:             IrType* type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
043152:             if (type_value && type_value->layout.resolved)
043153:             {
043154:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
043155:                     .type = type,
043156:                     .symbol = symbol,
043157:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE,
043158:                 };
043159:                 return true;
043160:             }
043161:         }
043162:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_FUNCTION && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)

043167:             {

043169:                     .type = pointer_type,

043172:                 };
043173:                 return result->symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;

043181: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, String8 name)
043182: {
043183:     if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
043184:     {
043185:         return true;
043186:     }
043187:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
043188:     if (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
043189:     {
043190:         for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < type->field_count; field_index += 1)
043191:         {
043192:             IrField* field = type->fields + field_index;
043193:             if (!string_equal(field->name, name))
043194:             {
043195:                 continue;
043196:             }
043197:             if (field->offset > INT64_MAX || value->addend > INT64_MAX - (s64)field->offset)
043198:             {
043199:                 return false;
043200:             }
043201:             value->type = field->type;
043202:             value->addend += (s64)field->offset;
043203:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
043204:             return true;
043205:         }
043206:     }
043207: 
043208:     return false;
043209: }

043211: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_index(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, u64 index)
043212: {
043213:     if (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
043214:     {
043215:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
043216:         if (!type || (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE && value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER) ||
043217:             (type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER))
043218:         {
043219:             return false;
043220:         }
043221:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
043222:         if (!element || !element->layout.resolved || element->layout.size > INT64_MAX || index > (u64)INT64_MAX / BUSTER_MAX((u64)1, element->layout.size))
043223:         {
043224:             return false;
043225:         }
043226:         s64 offset = (s64)(index * element->layout.size);
043227:         if (value->addend > INT64_MAX - offset)
043228:         {
043229:             return false;
043230:         }
043231:         value->type = type->element_type;
043232:         value->addend += offset;
043233:         value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
043234:     }
043235: 
043236:     return true;
043237: }

043256: // IEEE-754 binary16 -- the representation of `_Float16` -- as bits and back.
043257: // There is no host half type to convert through: this compiler builds under
043258: // four C compilers and cross-compiles, so the format is encoded arithmetically
043259: // with round-to-nearest-even, and the subnormal, overflow and NaN cases are
043260: // spelled out rather than inherited from a host conversion.
043261: //
043262: // The f64 carrier every folded constant travels in is exact over the whole
043263: // binary16 range -- the largest finite value is 65504 and the smallest
043264: // subnormal 2^-24, both exact in binary64 -- so this pair is the only place a
043265: // half constant rounds, and a value that reaches it has not been rounded
043266: // before.
043267: enum
043268: {
043269:     C_IR_FLOAT16_SIGNIFICAND_BITS = 10,
043270:     C_IR_FLOAT16_EXPONENT_BIAS = 15,
043271:     // The all-ones exponent field: the infinity/NaN encoding, and one past the
043272:     // largest finite exponent a rounded result may carry.
043273:     C_IR_FLOAT16_EXPONENT_SPECIAL = 0x1f,
043274:     // binary64 keeps 42 significand bits more than binary16 does.
043275:     C_IR_FLOAT16_SIGNIFICAND_SHIFT = 52 - C_IR_FLOAT16_SIGNIFICAND_BITS,
043276:     C_IR_FLOAT16_INFINITY = C_IR_FLOAT16_EXPONENT_SPECIAL << C_IR_FLOAT16_SIGNIFICAND_BITS,
043277:     // A quiet NaN with no payload; see the NaN arm below for why the quiet bit
043278:     // is set rather than carried over.
043279:     C_IR_FLOAT16_QUIET_NAN = C_IR_FLOAT16_INFINITY | (1 << (C_IR_FLOAT16_SIGNIFICAND_BITS - 1)),
043280: };
043281:
